_about: AUTO GEAR UPGRADES + equipment lock (example). The dashboard Gear page writes Scripts/data/gear_auto.json; without that file the bots NEVER buy or swap gear by themselves (default off). default = every character; parties.<leader>.auto = one party; chars.<name>.auto = one character (wins); chars.<name>.lock = true: nothing is bought, put on or swapped for that character. sameGradeSwap false = only a HIGHER grade replaces a worn item; keepArmorType true = heavy / light / robe stays. Even when on, the bots never change the weapon TYPE (spear stays spear, bow stays bow), never take a lower grade and never put a shield next to a two-handed weapon, unless your own gear plan (Gear page) names that item.
